legal.affiliateDisclosure: Nutriprofits partner links (nplink.net). Purchase and payment are completed on the partner store — not on VistulaVogue.
legal.introText: Please read the VistulaVogue website terms carefully. Below is a side-by-side breakdown of the terms — including the affiliate recommendation model — and what they actually mean in plain, human-friendly English.
legal.privacyIntroText: We value your privacy and trust above all. Below is a side-by-side breakdown of our Privacy Policy (RODO/GDPR compliant) and what it actually means for your data in plain, human-friendly English.
legal.stubMessage: Full document content will be published soon in compliance with UOKiK requirements.

merchant.title: 1. Publisher Identity
merchant.legal: The VistulaVogue website at https://polish-mcommerce.vercel.app is operated by an independent website publisher/developer of VistulaVogue (a natural person, not a limited-liability company). The publisher is not a Polish seller and has no seller NIP. The site recommends Nutriprofits partner products; purchases and payment are completed on the partner store, not on this website. Email contact: meenaarpit907@gmail.com.
merchant.plain: This is not a Sp. z o.o. store. An independent publisher runs the site and recommends Nutriprofits partner products — you pay and receive delivery from the partner store. Write to meenaarpit907@gmail.com.

payments.title: 2. Recommendations & Partner Purchases
payments.legal: VistulaVogue does not sell as a Polish trader and does not collect card, BLIK, or bank-transfer payments on this website. Product links may be Nutriprofits affiliate links. Prices, payment methods, delivery, and the sales contract are set by the partner store where the purchase is completed.
payments.plain: We do not sell products on this site and we do not collect card numbers. Clicking a recommendation takes you to the partner store, where you buy.

returns.title: 3. Returns & Withdrawal
returns.legal: Because the sales contract is formed with the partner store, withdrawal, returns, and refunds are governed by the partner’s terms and applicable consumer-protection law. The VistulaVogue publisher is not a party to the sales contract for recommended products.
returns.plain: Returns and withdrawal are handled with the partner store you bought from — not with this website.

complaints.title: 4. Complaints & Contact
complaints.legal: Complaints about purchased products should be directed to the seller on the partner store, under that store’s terms. Questions about the VistulaVogue website, recommendations, or personal data: meenaarpit907@gmail.com.
complaints.plain: Product issue? Contact the partner store. Questions about this site — meenaarpit907@gmail.com.

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.legal: The controller of personal data processed in connection with the VistulaVogue website (https://polish-mcommerce.vercel.app) is the independent website publisher/developer of VistulaVogue (a natural person, not a limited-liability company). The publisher is not a Polish seller and has no seller NIP. For data-protection matters: meenaarpit907@gmail.com.
controller.plain: An independent publisher — not a Sp. z o.o. — looks after data collected on this site. Privacy questions: meenaarpit907@gmail.com.

purpose.title: 2. Why We Collect Data
purpose.legal: Personal data (in particular email addresses) is processed in accordance with GDPR (RODO) for: the skin quiz and educational materials (Art. 6(1)(b) or (f)), site-related contact (Art. 6(1)(f)), marketing and newsletter communications only with your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)), and keeping the website secure and operational. This website does not process data to perform its own sales contracts or seller tax/accounting duties, because it does not sell products as a Polish trader.
purpose.plain: We mainly collect data to send your quiz report, answer messages, and — only if you opt in — a newsletter. We do not collect data in order to sell you a product on this site.

sharing.title: 3. Data Sharing & Recipients
sharing.legal: Data may be processed by hosting and technical infrastructure providers (including Vercel) to operate the website. If you continue to a Nutriprofits partner store, further purchase data is processed by that partner under its own terms. We do not sell your data. This website does not share data with couriers or payment gateways, because it does not complete its own sales.
sharing.plain: We never sell your data. Hosting keeps the site online. When you buy from a partner, that partner processes the order data.

retention.title: 4. Data Retention Period
retention.legal: Data related to operating the website (for example quiz or newsletter records) is stored for as long as needed for the stated purpose or until you withdraw consent. Marketing data is deleted when consent is withdrawn. Because the publisher does not sell as a Polish trader, we do not keep seller sales or tax archives.
retention.plain: Newsletter data is deleted when you unsubscribe. We do not keep 5-year sales tax files, because we are not the seller.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights (RODO/GDPR)
rights.legal: Under GDPR, you have the right to access your personal data, request rectification, deletion ('right to be forgotten'), restriction of processing, data portability, and the right to lodge a complaint with the President of UODO (Stawki 2, Warsaw).
rights.plain: You own your data! You can ask us at any time to view, edit, or completely delete your personal details. You also have the right to lodge a formal complaint if you think we've handled things incorrectly.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies & Tracking
cookies.legal: Our website uses cookies to ensure basic functionality, secure user sessions, and analyze site traffic. You can adjust your cookie settings at any time in your browser, though disabling them may affect store functionalities.
cookies.plain: We use small files called cookies to keep you logged in, secure the checkout, and see which products are popular. You can turn them off in your browser whenever you want.
